upstream: capability registry snapshot：既有 API / CLI / MCP 台帳、history、owner_task、boundary 與 next_action
runtime probe evidence：claude mcp list / get 的非 secret health output、Heptabase CLI list/version、Playwright CLI version probe、Codex MCP 設定形狀
contract verifier evidence：notification adapter contract verifier、capability registry verifier、wiring gate verifier
